Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for our calim file. Can you state your full name
for the record?
A: I'd rather just go by my initials for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through Baytown, Texas, on a weekday afternoon. Traffic had slowed down ahead of a light, so I was
already stopped when it happened.
Q: Understood. What happened next?
A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from the back, and my head snapped forward and then back
against the seat.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?
A: I did, but I felt stiff almsot right away. I walked around for a minute and then sat down on the curb because my
lower back was tightening up.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that evening. They examined my back and told me I had a lumbar strain. They
gave me a muscle relaxer and told me to rest and avoid heavy lifting.
Q: Have you had any prior problems with your back?
A: Nothing serious. I've had occasional soreness after long days on my feet, but nothing that stopped me from
working.
Q: How are you feeling at the moment?
A: Better than the first few days, but I still get a sharp ache when I bend over or sit for a long time. I've been doing
gentle stretches as the clinic suggested.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want to cooperate fully and get this resolved. I'll send over any follow-up paperwork from the clinic.
Q: Thank you. That cocnludes the statement.
</page>

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
